verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents a RESTful API that pushes data in and bundles up to 50 calls per batch request to stay within rate limits, which loosely supports contact writes at scale. Nothing in the pack names subscriber create/update endpoints, custom fields over the API (custom fields appear only in the Mailchimp importer), or suppression. Missing for 10: explicit subscriber create/update API documentation, custom-field writes via the API, suppression/unsubscribe endpoints, documented rate limits or throughput, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, and suppress contacts with custom properties through the API at production scale

citations.quote: Push or pull data from our RESTful API.
Bundle up to 50 API calls into a single batch request to stay within MailerLite's rate limits.
